caption: The drawing depicts a wooden corner table with a reddish-brown finish, featuring a triangular top surface fitted with a curved, raised backboard. The backboard has a short central shelf and is flanked by two small round compartments embedded in the surface, as well as an oval compartment near the center. Beneath the top, the enclosed space is supported by three slender legs, each placed at a corner of the triangular form. The legs extend downward, slightly flaring outward at the feet, and are connected near the base by an angular stretcher with a diamond-shaped cutout at its center. The table includes a single, centrally placed drawer on the front face, adorned with simple brass or gold-toned trim and a round pull handle. The paper background is a plain, off-white color, and the drawing is rendered with soft shading and careful attention to the wood grain and detailing.
title: Corner Wash-stand
